relationship.original_equation: Adjusted EBITDA = adjusted EBIT + software and R&D amortisation + eligible depreciation + post-IPO share-based compensation

assumptions: Adjusted EBIT already reflects the issuer’s separate reconciliation from reported operating profit; the additional expenses here have not already been added back.
All components use consistent entity, period and currency; the issuer excludes accelerated depreciation from this additional depreciation line.
limitations: This is ConvaTec’s 2016 issuer-specific non-IFRS metric, not a universal definition of adjusted EBITDA.
Exclusions can hide recurring or economically relevant costs, including equity dilution, and the metric is not free cash flow.
Definitions can change by issuer and reporting period; inspect each actual reconciliation.
